name: What is the cost per square foot for a whole-home remodel in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot for a whole-home renovation in Los Angeles, and what does that range actually include?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical cost per square foot for a whole-home renovation in Los Angeles, and what does that range actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost per square foot is useful only when you know what is included. In Los Angeles, lighter remodels with mostly cosmetic upgrades can land near the lower end of the range, while full renovations with kitchen and bathroom rebuilds, wall removal, upgraded systems, and premium finishes move much higher. Projects that involve structural changes, old-home system replacement, or custom millwork often exceed simple square-foot math. If you compare bids, make sure each contractor is pricing the same scope, because one estimate may include permits, design coordination, and allowances while another does not. The best way to use this metric is as a screening tool, then confirm it with room-by-room pricing and a detailed scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole-home renovation costs in Los Angeles commonly range from about $125 to $500+ per square foot, depending on scope and finish level. Dry rooms cost less, while kitchens, bathrooms, and projects with plumbing, electrical, or structural changes cost much more. Luxury gut renovations can exceed $800 per square foot.
